records.subject: 米海尔·罗亚·法尔丹姆杨 / 艾蕾西亚
records.summary: Remake Ciel source says Roa's consciousness began waking when Elesia was twelve and produced impulses toward bodily destruction of others.
records.effectRaw: 12岁时罗亚意识开始苏醒; 产生针对他人的肢体破坏冲动

records.subject: 米海尔·罗亚·法尔丹姆杨 / 爱尔奎特 / 二十七祖
records.summary: Remake Ciel source says Roa controlled all town residents, collected blood, invited multiple Twenty-seven Ancestors for an anti-Arcueid ritual, and Arcueid intervened to kill the fifteenth Roa; the Church named the event the France Incident.
records.effectRaw: 罗亚控制全镇居民并收集血液; 邀请多位二十七祖举行针对爱尔奎特的仪式; 爱尔奎特介入击杀第十五世罗亚; 法兰西事变
